intro: We hold a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh for {{count}} published MA colleges in India. This list of the best MA colleges under ₹{{budget}} lakh starts with Delhi University colleges, then a wide set of state and private colleges.

Miranda House is listed with MA English at ₹14,530, and Hindu College at ₹24,250. Several later cards sit at exactly ₹10,000, which is our lowest quotable fee, so confirm whether that official amount is annual.
Maharashtra, Haryana, Delhi NCR, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan and Tamil Nadu have the most listings. CUET PG is the main recorded entrance test.
listLead: These are the top MA colleges in India 2026 with a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹1 lakh. Cards are tied to a subject such as English, History or Education, so compare the official subject, not only the college name.
snapshot: Across {{feeN}} published colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private, {{public}} are public, and one has no ownership type. Delhi, Jaipur, Bhopal, Faridabad and Pune appear most often.
Three records have a fee band that can exceed ₹1 lakh. A public-university MA can still add exam or alumni charges that are not in our stored total.
firstCollegesLead: Shikshan Maharshi Dadasaheb Limaya College, Navi Mumbai, and Vidyant Hindu PG College, Lucknow, are both listed near ₹10,000 for MA History. Treat those figures as a prompt to open the official two-year fee notice.
Mithibai College of Arts, Mumbai, is listed with MA English at ₹10,838. Central University of Odisha is listed at ₹10,720 for MA English. Both need an official, current circular.

sections.heading: Subject, duration and entrance tests
paragraphs: An MA English card and an MA Education card are not interchangeable, even when the recorded fees are close.
CUET PG is recorded at four colleges here. Many university MA admissions still use a department entrance test or merit list that is not tagged on the card.

compare.heading: How to compare the best MA colleges under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: A Delhi University MA and a state-college MA can share this budget and still differ in supervision, library access and official yearly fees.
bullets: The official subject and duration, and whether the fee is annual or for both years.
The latest college or university fee circular, including exam charges.
The admission route, including CUET PG or a department test.
Hostel and city living costs, which are not included in the tuition figure.

faqs.question: How many MA colleges in India have fees under ₹1 lakh here?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published MA colleges with a recorded main-programme fee up to ₹{{budget}} lakh. Colleges without a usable fee on file are excluded.

faqs.question: What is a typical MA fee on this list?
faqs.answer: The median recorded total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. Confirm whether the official notice is for one year or the full MA.

faqs.question: What do Miranda House and Hindu College show for MA English?
faqs.answer: Our records list Miranda House at ₹14,530 and Hindu College at ₹24,250 for MA English. Use the latest official college circular, because university fees change by year.

faqs.question: Why do some MA fees sit at ₹10,000?
faqs.answer: ₹10,000 is the lowest figure we treat as quotable. Anything under ₹10,000 is dropped as a likely data error. A fee at the floor may still be annual, so check the official notice.

faqs.question: Is this a ranking of the best MA colleges under ₹1 lakh?
faqs.answer: No. It is a fee filter. Subject, department and the official circular should guide the shortlist.
